Ngangu ngu ti acide $A$ ayeke na $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}$ na $B$ ayeke na $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ M}$. Fango ngangu ti hydrogène na $A$ ahon ti $B$ fani oke?
20261122-chemistry-g06-2.thinking.1: Bibe ti ndara na gingo nda ti ye
20261122-chemistry-g06-2.s.s1.prompt: [E6 Gingo ti Simi (Ti kota)] Kpale ti diko wungo ti ye na ndo ti Acide na base. Ngangu ngu ti acide $A$ ayeke na $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}$ na $B$ ayeke na $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ M}$. Fango ngangu ti hydrogène na $A$ ahon ti $B$ fani oke?
20261122-chemistry-g06-2.s.s1.explain:
Tamba 1: $[\text{H}^+]_A = 10^{-3}\text{ M}$, $[\text{H}^+]_B = 10^{-5}\text{ M}$.
Tamba 2: Fango ni $\frac{1.0 \times 10^{-3}}{1.0 \times 10^{-5}} = 10^2 = 100$.
Tamba 3: Ngangu ti $A$ ahon ti $B$ fani 100.
